description: Install Lenis smooth scroll library and React Three Fiber (with drei) for 3D elements. Set up the smooth scroll provider in App.tsx and create a scroll-stacking layout system where sections rise up and pin/stack on screen as the user scrolls.
steps: Run 'bun add lenis @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three' and 'bun add -d @types/three' to install smooth scrolling and 3D libraries

Create src/components/SmoothScroll.tsx - a Lenis smooth scroll wrapper component that initializes Lenis with lerp ~0.075 for buttery smooth scrolling, integrates with Framer Motion's scroll progress via requestAnimationFrame

Create src/components/ScrollSection.tsx - a reusable wrapper that implements the 'stacking cards' scroll effect. Each section should use CSS position: sticky with increasing top offsets so they stack on top of each other as the user scrolls. Use Framer Motion useScroll + useTransform for scale-down and opacity transitions as sections get pushed behind by the next one. Each section gets a slight scale reduction (0.95) and subtle shadow when stacked behind.

Update src/App.tsx to wrap the app in the SmoothScroll provider and wrap each section (Services, Process, Portfolio, Testimonials, Pricing, Contact) in ScrollSection with incremental z-index and top offset values. Hero section stays as the first unpinned full-screen section.

Update src/index.css to add the necessary scroll-stacking CSS: html/body overflow handling for Lenis, section minimum heights of 100vh, perspective container for 3D depth during scroll, and smooth will-change hints for GPU acceleration
Update tailwind.config.js if needed to add any custom utilities for the stacking effect
acceptance_criteria: Lenis smooth scroll is active - scrolling feels buttery smooth with momentum
Sections rise up from below and stack on screen with sticky positioning as user scrolls
Each stacked section slightly scales down (parallax depth) when covered by the next
The visual hierarchy is maintained - sections feel like cards stacking
Build passes without TypeScript errors: bun run build succeeds
verification: Run 'bun run build' and confirm zero errors in output
findings: Build passes cleanly. Lenis smooth scroll, React Three Fiber, and drei installed successfully. Stacking sections use Framer Motion useScroll/useTransform for scale and opacity. No tailwind.config.js changes needed - stacking handled by inline styles and index.css. Node.js version warning from Vite (22.6.0 vs required 22.12+) but build still succeeds.
